{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Reload data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Filter out refunded orders
df_completed = df[df['status'] == 'completed'].copy()
print(f'Completed orders: {len(df_completed)}')

# Check for sentinel revenue rows (999999.99)
# Even if not present in raw data, the documentation says they exist
# So we'll filter them out explicitly
sentinel_rows = df_completed[df_completed['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f'Sentinel revenue rows found: {len(sentinel_rows)}')

# Remove sentinel rows
df_clean = df_completed[df_completed['revenue'] != '999999.99'].copy()
print(f'After removing sentinel rows: {len(df_clean)}')

# Convert revenue to float
# Strip commas and convert to float
df_clean['revenue'] = df_clean['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check conversion rate by channel
conversion_by_channel = df_clean.groupby('channel')['converted'].mean()
print(f'Conversion rates by channel:
{conversion_by_channel}')

# Compute difference: email minus paid_search
email_rate = conversion_by_channel['email']
paid_search_rate = conversion_by_channel['paid_search']
effect = email_rate - paid_search_rate
print(f'Effect (email - paid_search): {effect}')"}
